subject: [PATCH v5 11/11] selftests/mm: add PMD swap entry tests

reviews.author: Luiz Capitulino
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Luiz Capitulino suggested checking /proc/swaps instead of the current implementation for the first test-case, citing that if it fails due to a bug, the test would be skipped.

The reviewer suggested that skipping on failure in PMD swap entry tests may hide potential regressions and recommended returning different error codes instead, also noting that this applies to all tests calling alloc_fill_swap_thp().

Reviewer Luiz Capitulino suggested improving test coverage by swapping out multiple PMD pages or a PMD page and a base page, noting that the current tests only swap-out single PMD pages.

Reviewer Luiz Capitulino suggested moving the swapoff() call to this location, citing that it would eliminate the repeated swapoff() calls in the test.
reviews.raw_body:
Why not check /proc/swaps instead? We're performing the first test-case
here, if this fails because of a bug the test would be skipped.

---

I think that skipping on failure may hide potential regressions. If the
intent is to skip when you don't get a PMD THP, then you could return
different error codes but do fail the test if swapping fails. Note that
this applies to all the tests calling alloc_fill_swap_thp().

---

Since all the tests already swap-out a single PMD page, I think we could improve
coverage by swapping out multiple PMD pages or maybe a PMD page and a
base page.

---

Should swapoff() be moved here? I think it would avoid the repeated
swapoff() calls in the test.

2026-08-05.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test suite for PMD swap entry paths in the Linux kernel. The tests exercise various code paths, including swap-out and swap-in round-trip, fork with read-only access, COW isolation, repeated swap cycles, write faults, userfaultfd RWP preservation, munmap, mprotect, UFFDIO_MOVE, mremap, pagemap reading, mincore, MADV_FREE, MADV_WILLNEED, and swapoff. The tests are designed to verify the correctness of PMD-mapped THPs under different scenarios, including with and without zswap enabled. The patch also adds a new category 'pmd_swap' and a wrapper script 'ksft_pmd_swap.sh' to run the test suite.
